<article class="brief brief-major"><h2 class="brief-headline"><a href="{{ '/bodies/cotw-finance/meetings/diligent-1633/' | relative_url }}">County negotiates reduced bridge maintenance cost with tollway</a></h2><p class="brief-body">Boone County is finalizing an agreement with the Illinois Tollway, City of Belvidere, and Flora Township that would dramatically reduce local costs for Irene Road bridge maintenance. The total local cost would be $180,000 split between county and city.</p><p class="brief-credit">COTW – Finance, Taxation &amp; Salaries · Sep 10, 2026</p></article>
<article class="brief brief-major"><h2 class="brief-headline"><a href="{{ '/bodies/cotw-admin/meetings/diligent-1632/' | relative_url }}">County secures state funding for seven-bridge replacement project</a></h2><p class="brief-body">The county approved agreements for a bundled bridge replacement project covering seven bridges across Boone County, Boone Township, and McHenry County. The state will fully fund construction, estimated at $15 to 20 million, and manage bidding. Boone County was the first in Illinois to participate in the state's bridge bundling program.</p><p class="brief-credit">COTW – Administrative &amp; Legislative · Sep 3, 2026</p></article>

<article class="brief brief-minor"><h2 class="brief-headline"><a href="{{ '/bodies/d100-ptac/meetings/d100-986/' | relative_url }}">District updates cell phone policy to cover META glasses</a></h2><p class="brief-body">Belvidere District 100 is adding wearable personal devices and META glasses to its cell phone and electronic device policy in the upcoming parent and student handbook. <article class="brief brief-minor"><h2 class="brief-headline"><a href="{{ '/bodies/belvidere-cow/meetings/belvidere-cow-20260824/' | relative_url }}">City waives YMCA building fees for renovation project</a></h2><p class="brief-body">The council unanimously waived building permit fees for the YMCA's $670,000 Phase 1 renovation, which will relocate the fitness center and add community programming space. <article class="brief brief-minor"><h2 class="brief-headline"><a href="{{ '/bodies/cotw-admin/meetings/diligent-1632/' | relative_url }}">Animal Services shifts to rescue partnerships as vet costs triple</a></h2><p class="brief-body">Animal Services Director Kelly Jesy told the committee that veterinary costs have tripled since a local clinic became corporate. The department operates without property tax funding, relying instead on fees and donations.</p><p class="brief-credit">COTW – Administrative &amp; Legislative · Sep 3, 2026</p></article>
<article class="brief brief-minor"><h2 class="brief-headline"><a href="{{ '/bodies/belvidere-council/meetings/belvidere-council-20260908/' | relative_url }}">Council approves video gaming for Logan Avenue 7-Eleven</a></h2><p class="brief-body">City Council approved a special use permit allowing 7-Eleven at 707 Logan Avenue to add a video gaming area with alcohol consumption.
